title: Builder BLD-203: Layout chips with needs and pins

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-203.

detail:
B2 Roles, pass BLD-203 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-203). Layout chips with needs and pins. Scope: components/builder/canvas/variants. Build: Chips from variants with thumb; a chip whose needs are unmet shows why and a shortcut to fill the slot. Picking a chip sets variant and variantSet: true and shows a pin. Unpin restores the theme default via roleVariant(). Done when: roleVariant priority holds: owner, then theme, then role default; Every variant renders non-empty with sample content on every theme. Gates: vitest suite (required test job), audit:themes render matrix, pr-compare visual suite, Pass probes, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: BLD-201, BLD-104. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.

The settings panel opens with Layout for a role section: one chip per role.json variant with its sketch (variants[x].thumb), the one in use pressed. A chip whose needs the section does not meet stays visible, reads 'Needs a photo' (or the slot's own label) and its button opens that field in Tune. Picking a chip writes variant plus variantSet: true in one undo step and lights 'Kept'; the switch 'Keep this layout when the theme changes' unpins (variant '' and variantSet false), so roleVariant() falls back to the theme's default and then the role's. Tune no longer draws a role's variant select. lib/builder/variants.test.ts proves the priority, pin through every theme, unpin, needs, and that every role x variant x 13 themes renders non-empty with sample content. Render: scripts/render/builder-layout-chips.render.tsx.
